places.name: Lonehill
places.summary: A residential suburb in the far north of the city, next to Fourways. We list no visitor sights here yet; Fourways' shopping centres are a short drive away.

places.name: Fourways
places.summary: A busy suburb in the far north of the city, known for large shopping centres and the Montecasino entertainment complex.
places.good_for: Shopping, theatre and a family day out

places.name: Glenferness
places.summary: A residential area in the far north of the city. We list no visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Halfway House
places.summary: A suburb in Midrand, named for its position roughly halfway between Johannesburg and Pretoria. Mostly offices, homes and shops.

places.name: Glen Austin
places.summary: A semi-rural area of smallholdings in Midrand, in the far north of the city. We list no visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Jukskei Park
places.summary: A residential suburb in the north-west of the city, named after the Jukskei River. We list no visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Douglasdale
places.summary: A residential suburb in the north of the city, between Sandton and Fourways. We list no visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Olivedale
places.summary: A residential suburb in the north-west of the city, near Randburg. We list no visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Randpark Ridge
places.summary: A residential suburb in the north-west of the city, near Randburg. We list no visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Ferndale
places.summary: A residential suburb next to the Randburg town centre, in the north-west of the city. We list no visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Fairland
places.summary: A residential suburb in the north-west of the city, near Randburg and Northcliff. We list no visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Craighall Park
places.geo_source: Owner: the corner of Waterfall Avenue and Athole Avenue, looked up in OpenStreetMap
places.notes: Centre: the corner of Waterfall Avenue and Athole Avenue, from the owner (a local); the corner's position is from OpenStreetMap. Locals call this side, east of Jan Smuts Avenue up to Sandhurst, Craighall Park.

places.name: Craighall
places.notes: Locals: Craighall is the bigger side west of Jan Smuts Avenue, towards Linden and Bordeaux. Needs a centre: a street corner from the owner, looked up in OpenStreetMap.

places.name: Robindale
places.summary: A residential suburb in the north-west of the city, near Randburg. We list no visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Linden
places.summary: A residential suburb in the north-west of the city with a choice of restaurants and cafés. It is a short drive from Melville and Parkhurst.

places.name: Northcliff
places.summary: A suburb on and around Northcliff Hill, one of the highest points in the city. Quiet, leafy streets with views over the northern suburbs.

places.name: Emmarentia
places.summary: A leafy suburb around Emmarentia Dam, where people walk, run and sail. The Johannesburg Botanical Garden is on the dam's edge.
places.good_for: Walks, picnics and the Botanical Garden

places.name: Florida
places.summary: A suburb in the north-west of the city, close to Roodepoort, built around Florida Lake. Mostly homes and shops.

places.name: Triomf
places.summary: Built in the 1950s on the site of Sophiatown, whose residents were forced to leave under apartheid. The name Sophiatown was restored in 2006.

places.name: Melville
places.summary: A relaxed suburb with a strip of cafés, bookshops and bars along 7th Street, close to the Melville Koppies nature reserve.
places.good_for: Cafés, live music, a walk on the koppies

places.name: Sandton
places.summary: The business and shopping heart of northern Johannesburg. Sandton City, Nelson Mandela Square, many hotels and a Gautrain station sit close together.
places.good_for: Shopping, hotels and a Gautrain base
places.notes: A name for a group of suburbs (see the Sandton area list), so it has no position of its own and is not drawn as itself.

places.name: Bryanston
places.summary: An established northern suburb with large gardens, a shopping centre and a well-known organic market. A short drive from Sandton.
places.good_for: A market morning and a quiet meal

places.name: Rivonia
places.summary: A northern suburb known for Liliesleaf, the farm where anti-apartheid leaders were arrested in 1963 and which is now a museum. Also home to offices and restaurants.
places.good_for: Liliesleaf and the Rivonia Trial story

places.name: Woodmead
places.summary: A business district on the N1 north of Sandton, with offices and retail parks. Most visitors pass through on the way to somewhere else.

places.name: Morningside
places.summary: A residential suburb on the edge of Sandton, with a shopping centre and a number of restaurants. It lies close to the Sandton Gautrain station.

places.name: River Club
places.summary: A small suburb in the Sandton area, in the north of the city. We list no visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Sandown
places.summary: The part of Sandton around Sandton City and Nelson Mandela Square. Shops, restaurants, hotels and the Sandton Gautrain station are all within walking distance.
places.good_for: Shopping, hotels and a Gautrain station

places.name: Buccleuch
places.summary: A suburb beside the N1 in the north of the city, with offices and light industry. We list no visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Modderfontein
places.summary: Once the site of a dynamite factory founded in the 1890s. Today it mixes new housing and offices with the Modderfontein Reserve, which has walking trails.

places.name: Kelvin
places.summary: A mostly industrial and commercial suburb on the north-eastern side of the city. We list no visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Bordeaux
places.summary: A residential suburb in the north-west of the city, close to Randburg and Craighall. We list no visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Parkmore
places.summary: A suburb just west of Sandton's business centre, with offices, apartment blocks and houses. It is one of the Parks and also counted as part of Sandton.

places.name: Hurlingham
places.summary: A residential suburb in the Sandton area, in the north of the city. We list no visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Sandhurst
places.summary: One of the city's wealthiest residential suburbs, close to Sandton's centre. Large houses sit behind high walls, so it is a place to drive through rather than visit.

places.name: Wynberg
places.summary: A mostly industrial and commercial suburb next to Alexandra, on the north-eastern side of the city. We list no visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Alexandra
places.summary: A dense township founded in 1912, just east of Sandton. Nelson Mandela lived here in the 1940s. Go with a local guide.

places.name: Hyde Park
places.summary: A wealthy residential suburb best known for Hyde Park Corner, a shopping centre with fashion and homeware shops, restaurants and cafés.

places.name: The Parks
places.summary: A local name for a group of leafy suburbs north of the city centre whose names start with Park, from Parkhurst and Parkview to Parktown.
places.good_for: Restaurants, Zoo Lake and old houses
places.notes: A name for a group of suburbs (see The Parks area list), so it has no position of its own and is not drawn as itself.

places.name: Parkhurst
places.summary: A residential suburb known for 4th Avenue, a street of restaurants, cafés and independent shops. One of the Parks.

places.name: Parktown North
places.summary: A residential suburb with a mix of houses and offices, north of Parkwood and Parkhurst. One of the Parks.

places.name: Parkwood
places.summary: A quiet residential suburb close to Rosebank, between Parkhurst and Parktown North. One of the Parks.

places.name: Parkview
places.summary: A leafy residential suburb beside Zoo Lake, with a golf course and a small strip of shops and restaurants on Tyrone Avenue. One of the Parks.
places.good_for: Zoo Lake, picnics and a quiet lunch

places.name: Parktown
places.summary: A suburb on a ridge north of Braamfontein, known for its old houses, many designed by Herbert Baker, and for several large hospitals. One of the Parks.

places.name: Illovo
places.summary: A suburb between Sandton and Rosebank along Oxford Road, with offices, apartment blocks and restaurants.
places.good_for: Restaurants and a base near both

places.name: Melrose
places.summary: An upmarket suburb best known for Melrose Arch, a walkable precinct of restaurants, shops, offices and hotels.

places.name: Rosebank
places.summary: A compact business and shopping district with its own Gautrain station, a weekend rooftop market and several galleries.

places.name: Saxonwold
places.summary: A leafy suburb of old houses and large gardens, home to the Johannesburg Zoo. Zoo Lake is next door.

places.name: Orchards
places.summary: A residential suburb in the north-east of the city. We list no visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Sandringham
places.summary: A residential suburb in the north-east of the city. We list no visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Edenvale
places.summary: A town just east of Johannesburg, in the Ekurhuleni municipality, close to OR Tambo International Airport. Mostly homes, shops and light industry.

places.name: Houghton
places.summary: A leafy, wealthy suburb where Nelson Mandela lived for many years and died in 2013. The Nelson Mandela Foundation has its offices here. The Mandela home is private.

places.name: Observatory
places.geo_source: OpenStreetMap: Observatory Park, in the suburb (the search matched an observatory far away)
places.summary: A residential suburb on a ridge east of the city centre, named after the observatory built there in the early 1900s. Observatory Park is in the suburb.

places.name: Bruma
places.summary: A suburb in the east of the city, centred on Bruma Lake. Mostly shops, offices and apartment blocks.

places.name: Bedfordview
places.summary: A suburb just east of Johannesburg on the N3, in the Ekurhuleni municipality, with the Eastgate shopping centre and a number of restaurants.
places.good_for: Shopping and restaurants on the way to the airport

places.name: Braamfontein
places.summary: A student district next to Wits University. Rooftop bars, galleries, coffee shops and a busy Saturday food market.

places.name: Newtown
places.summary: A cultural quarter in the west of the city centre, home to the Market Theatre and Mary Fitzgerald Square.

places.name: Yeoville
places.summary: A busy, mixed suburb east of Hillbrow. Rockey Street was known for its bars and live music, and the area has long been home to many people from other African countries.
places.good_for: Local history and a lively street

places.name: Maboneng
places.summary: A small, walkable precinct on the east side of the city centre, known for street art, galleries, independent shops and restaurants.

places.name: Joubert Park
places.geo_source: OpenStreetMap: Joubert Park, the park the suburb is named after

places.name: Kempton Park
places.geo_source: Owner: Gautrain station file (Rhodesfield station, in Kempton Park)
places.summary: A town east of Johannesburg, in the Ekurhuleni municipality, and home to O.R. Tambo International Airport and the Gautrain's airport station. Mostly homes, offices and light industry.
places.notes: The position is Rhodesfield Gautrain station, a point in Kempton Park, not the town centre. Replace it with the centre (OpenStreetMap, or a street corner from the owner) when a lookup is possible.

places.name: Kensington
places.summary: A residential suburb in the east of the city. We list no visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Auckland Park
places.summary: A suburb in the west of the city, home to the Kingsway campus of the University of Johannesburg and the main studios of the SABC.

places.name: Riverlea
places.summary: A residential suburb in the west of the city. We list no visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Eldorado Park
places.geo_source: OpenStreetMap: Eldoradopark (place, spelled as one word there)

places.name: Robertsham
places.summary: A residential suburb in the south of the city. We list no visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Kenilworth
places.summary: A residential suburb in the south of the city. We list no visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Meredale
places.summary: A suburb in the south of the city, home to the Southgate shopping centre.

places.name: Glenvista
places.summary: A residential suburb in the south of the city. We list no visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Soweto
places.summary: South Africa's best-known township and the heart of much of the country's history. Go with a local guide to get the most from it.
places.notes: Soweto as a whole. Its townships are listed and drawn one by one, so Soweto itself has no position. Kept for the neighbourhoods page card.

places.name: Orlando West
places.summary: The part of Soweto that most visitors see first. Vilakazi Street, Mandela House and the Hector Pieterson Memorial and Museum are all within a short walk of each other.
places.good_for: Mandela House, Vilakazi Street and the 1976 uprising

places.name: Diepkloof
places.summary: A township in Soweto, home to the Chris Hani Baragwanath Hospital. We list no other visitor sights here yet.

places.name: Lanseria
places.geo_source: Wikipedia: Lanseria International Airport (the area is named after it)

places.name: Hartbeespoort
places.summary: A dam and holiday town about an hour's drive north-west of the city, in North West province. Popular for weekend trips from Johannesburg.
places.good_for: A day out of the city

places.name: Benoni
places.notes: East Rand town in the Ekurhuleni municipality. Add a summary once the owner has something checkable to say. Drawn as an arrow on the map's east edge once it has a position: look it up with tools/fetch_map_sources.py or ask the owner for a street corner.

places.name: Boksburg
places.notes: East Rand town in the Ekurhuleni municipality. Add a summary once the owner has something checkable to say. Drawn as an arrow on the map's east edge once it has a position: look it up with tools/fetch_map_sources.py or ask the owner for a street corner.

places.name: Springs
places.notes: East Rand town in the Ekurhuleni municipality. Add a summary once the owner has something checkable to say. Drawn as an arrow on the map's east edge once it has a position: look it up with tools/fetch_map_sources.py or ask the owner for a street corner.

places.name: Brakpan
places.notes: East Rand town in the Ekurhuleni municipality. Add a summary once the owner has something checkable to say. Drawn as an arrow on the map's east edge once it has a position: look it up with tools/fetch_map_sources.py or ask the owner for a street corner.
